executive_summary: The existing post-compaction contract-re-read enforcement (core-protocol-gate.js reading protocolGate.fileReads) fires only at the next handoff, so role seats (Solomon, Adam, coordinator) -- which never run handoffs -- are uncovered by construction; drift flag ce3de628 (2026-09-02) is a witnessed miss. LEAD investigation (VALIDATION row dee7ea04/21ff50fc, Explore row e95179c6) corrected the original premise: the cited recordCompaction() is dead code on the dominant automatic-compaction path, and role registers actually read a DIFFERENT tracker (protocolFileReadStatus/contract_last_read_at) than the one core-protocol-gate.js clears. This PRD delivers a narrow, no-new-machinery fix: a pure comparison function wired into the already-wired PostToolUse hook (scripts/hooks/protocol-file-tracker.cjs) that flags a role seat whose contract_last_read_at is older than its own genuine last-compaction marker, at the next tool call rather than the next handoff -- leaving the existing worker-at-handoff path (protocolGate.fileReads, QF-20260524-337's preservation behavior) completely unchanged.

functional_requirements.title: Read a session's genuine last-compaction timestamp
functional_requirements.description: A new pure helper reads ~/.claude/flags/last-compaction.json (the ONE marker the real wired PreCompact hook, scripts/hooks/precompact-snapshot.ps1, writes on every firing -- auto and manual) and returns the timestamp for the CURRENT session only, filtering strictly on the marker's embedded sessionId field, because the file is shared per-machine across concurrent sessions and file identity alone is not a valid session filter.
acceptance_criteria: readLastCompactionForSession(sessionId) returns null when no marker exists or the marker's sessionId does not match
readLastCompactionForSession(sessionId) returns the marker's timestamp when the sessionId matches
A concurrent session's compaction marker for a DIFFERENT sessionId is never returned for this session

functional_requirements.title: Compare against the role seat's own contract-read tracker
functional_requirements.description: A new pure helper reads the SAME contract_last_read_at value the register scripts (scripts/adam-register.cjs:345 checkContractRead, scripts/coordinator-startup-check.mjs:642 mirror, scripts/solomon-register.cjs equivalent) already compute -- NOT protocolGate.fileReads, which role registers never consult (VALIDATION F5 / mechanism_verifications entries 4-5). needsRecheck(compactionAt, contractReadAt) is pure: true iff compactionAt is set AND (contractReadAt is unset OR contractReadAt is older than compactionAt).
acceptance_criteria: needsRecheck returns true when a genuine compaction postdates the last recorded contract read
needsRecheck returns false when the last recorded contract read postdates (or equals) the compaction marker
needsRecheck returns false when there is no genuine compaction marker for this session (nothing to react to)

functional_requirements.title: Enforce at the next tool call, for role seats only, without a new process
functional_requirements.description: Wire FR-1+FR-2 into scripts/hooks/protocol-file-tracker.cjs's existing PostToolUse firing (already fires for every tool call, every session, including Solomon which has no quiet-tick script -- solving the seat-roster gap without inventing a Solomon tick). On a flagged seat, print a diagnostic line (mirroring role-capture-gate.mjs's `ROLE_CAPTURE_GATE=... state=REQUIRED` idiom: `POST_COMPACTION_REREAD_REQUIRED role=<role> since=<compactionAt>`) rather than hard-blocking the call, gated behind a staged-rollout flag ROLE_COMPACTION_REREAD_ENFORCE_V1 (unset/false = warn-only diagnostic; true = the tool call is refused until a fresh contract read lands), matching this repo's established staged-enforcement convention (e.g. COORD_CONTEXT_CEILING_ENFORCE_V1).
acceptance_criteria: A role seat (adam, solomon, or coordinator) whose compaction marker postdates its contract_last_read_at is flagged on its next tool call, not deferred to a handoff
The flag clears automatically once contract_last_read_at advances past the compaction marker (a genuine re-read), never via a manual per-tick reset
With ROLE_COMPACTION_REREAD_ENFORCE_V1 unset, the flag is diagnostic-only (printed, not blocking) -- the default rollout posture
Solomon (no quiet-tick script) is checked correctly via the PostToolUse hook alone, with no Solomon-specific tick invented

functional_requirements.title: Preserve the existing worker-at-handoff path unchanged
functional_requirements.description: core-protocol-gate.js's protocolGate.fileReads clearing/blocking behavior at handoffs is NOT modified. QF-20260524-337's deliberate preservation of protocolGate across the real PreCompact hook (precompact-snapshot.ps1) is NOT reversed -- this SD's new check reads a separate tracker (FR-2) and never requires protocolGate.fileReads to clear on auto-compaction.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test asserts the worker-at-handoff path (protocolGate.fileReads / core-protocol-gate.js) is byte-for-byte unchanged in behavior
QF-20260524-337's own regression test (post-compaction /sd-create no longer false-blocks) still passes unmodified

technical_requirements.title: No new machinery
technical_requirements.description: No new DB table/column, no new cron/scheduled process, no new per-seat script. Single new file (a pure comparison module) plus one call-site addition inside the already-wired protocol-file-tracker.cjs PostToolUse hook. Per ratification 76a3c081.

technical_requirements.title: Session-scoped compaction marker read
technical_requirements.description: ~/.claude/flags/last-compaction.json is a single shared file per machine home directory, not partitioned by session. Every read MUST filter on the marker's embedded sessionId field; never trust file mtime or existence alone as a signal for THIS session.

technical_requirements.title: Staged rollout via existing env-flag convention
technical_requirements.description: ROLE_COMPACTION_REREAD_ENFORCE_V1 gates blocking behavior; unset/false is diagnostic-only. Mirrors COORD_CONTEXT_CEILING_ENFORCE_V1's staged-rollout shape already used in this codebase (lib/fleet/context-ceiling-checker.cjs).

test_scenarios.scenario: A role seat with a genuine (session-matching) compaction marker newer than its contract_last_read_at is flagged on its next tool call
test_scenarios.expected: needsRecheck returns true; the PostToolUse call site prints POST_COMPACTION_REREAD_REQUIRED for that role

test_scenarios.scenario: The SAME seat's subsequent ordinary action, taken AFTER a fresh contract re-read is recorded, is NOT flagged again
test_scenarios.expected: needsRecheck returns false once contract_last_read_at advances past the compaction marker -- proves the check clears rather than sticking, addressing the SD's own named routed-around risk

test_scenarios.scenario: The existing worker-at-handoff path is unchanged
test_scenarios.expected: core-protocol-gate.js's protocolGate.fileReads clearing/blocking behavior at a handoff is identical to pre-SD behavior
A post-compaction /sd-create attempt does not false-block, exactly as QF-20260524-337 fixed

test_scenarios.scenario: Solomon (no quiet-tick script) is still checked
test_scenarios.expected: A synthetic Solomon session with a stale contract read after compaction is flagged via the PostToolUse hook alone, with no Solomon-specific tick script involved

test_scenarios.scenario: A concurrent session's compaction marker on the same machine does not leak into this session's check
test_scenarios.expected: readLastCompactionForSession filters strictly by sessionId; a marker written for a different session is ignored

acceptance_criteria: A role seat (Solomon, Adam, or coordinator) that has compacted (auto OR manual) and then attempts ordinary work without re-reading its contract is refused or flagged, checked via protocolFileReadStatus/contract_last_read_at compared against the session-filtered last-compaction marker -- not via protocolGate.fileReads
The window between a compaction and the next handoff is no longer unguarded for workers either
Enforcement does not depend on self-authored prompt text surviving a seat rotation, and does not depend on a seat having its own quiet-tick script
The existing worker-at-handoff countermeasure is preserved unchanged and narrowly -- QF-20260524-337's protocolGate preservation is not reversed

risks.risk: A per-tick refusal gets routed around, the way the worktree reaper cadence was previously switched off
risks.mitigation: Refusal is once per compaction (not once per tick), clears automatically on a genuine re-read (TS-2), and ships as diagnostic-only by default (ROLE_COMPACTION_REREAD_ENFORCE_V1 unset) with an explicit later flip to blocking, so the rollout itself cannot be silently disabled the same way

risks.risk: The shared ~/.claude/flags/last-compaction.json marker races across concurrent sessions on the same machine
risks.mitigation: Every read filters strictly on the marker's embedded sessionId field (TS-6); the marker's existence or mtime alone is never treated as this session's signal

risks.risk: A third representation of protocol-file-read state is created, duplicating protocol-file-tracker.cjs's own 'must stay in sync with core-protocol-gate.js' warning (line 29)
risks.mitigation: This SD deliberately does NOT touch protocolGate.fileReads or core-protocol-gate.js (FR-4) -- it adds one new comparison over two already-existing signals, not a new state store

consumers: Solomon, Adam, and coordinator role sessions (via their existing tool-call flow, no new tick script)
dependencies: scripts/hooks/protocol-file-tracker.cjs (existing wired PostToolUse hook, call-site addition)
~/.claude/flags/last-compaction.json (written by scripts/hooks/precompact-snapshot.ps1 on every real PreCompact firing)
scripts/adam-register.cjs / scripts/solomon-register.cjs / scripts/coordinator-startup-check.mjs (existing contract_last_read_at readers, unmodified)
data_contracts: none -- reads existing file-based state only, no schema change
observability_rollout: Diagnostic-only rollout first (prints POST_COMPACTION_REREAD_REQUIRED, never blocks), matching this repo's established non-blocking-first convention (see scripts/lint/root-dirt-lint.mjs); flip to blocking is a documented follow-up, not part of this SD's acceptance bar

system_architecture.summary: One new pure comparison module plus one call-site addition inside the already-wired protocol-file-tracker.cjs PostToolUse hook -- no new process, table, or per-seat script.

implementation_approach.summary: Read-compare-flag: two already-existing signals, one new pure comparison, one call site. No new storage.
steps: Add lib/governance/post-compaction-role-recheck.cjs with the three pure functions (FR-1/FR-2)
Wire the check into scripts/hooks/protocol-file-tracker.cjs's PostToolUse handler for role sessions, gated by ROLE_COMPACTION_REREAD_ENFORCE_V1 defaulting to diagnostic-only (FR-3)
On flag: print POST_COMPACTION_REREAD_REQUIRED (mirrors role-capture-gate.mjs's ROLE_CAPTURE_GATE=...state=REQUIRED idiom) rather than hard-blocking by default
Ship regression tests preserving the worker-at-handoff path and QF-20260524-337's own test (TS-3, TS-4) alongside new unit/integration tests (TS-1, TS-2, TS-5, TS-6)
Michael is explicitly out of scope (formalized after this SD was authored); the host is seat-name-agnostic, so adding a 4th role later is a metadata-only change, not new machinery
